nodes.title: Neighborhood scores
nodes.content:
import pandas as pd

# Accessibility and coverage scores of twelve neighborhoods, three per side of the city.
return pd.DataFrame({
    "side": ["North"] * 3 + ["South"] * 3 + ["West"] * 3 + ["Central"] * 3,
    "accessibility": [0.62, 0.71, 0.55, 0.38, 0.44, 0.29, 0.47, 0.52, 0.41, 0.83, 0.79, 0.88],
    "coverage": [0.91, 0.85, 0.77, 0.64, 0.70, 0.58, 0.73, 0.69, 0.75, 0.97, 0.95, 0.99],
})
nodes.goal: Return 12 neighborhood scores: side (object: North, South, West or Central, three rows each), accessibility (float64), coverage (float64).

nodes.title: Hourly counts
nodes.content:
import pandas as pd

# Pedestrians and cyclists counted on State Street, one row per hour of one day.
hours = pd.date_range("2026-06-03 00:00", periods=24, freq="h")
pedestrians = [12, 8, 5, 4, 6, 20, 85, 240, 410, 380, 350, 420, 510, 480, 430, 450, 520, 610, 470, 300, 190, 110, 60, 30]
cyclists = [2, 1, 0, 0, 1, 6, 30, 95, 140, 110, 90, 100, 120, 115, 105, 110, 150, 170, 120, 70, 40, 20, 10, 5]

return pd.DataFrame({"hour": hours, "pedestrians": pedestrians, "cyclists": cyclists})
nodes.goal: Return 24 rows, one per hour of one day: hour (datetime64[ns]), pedestrians (int64), cyclists (int64).
